notes.title: Quadrillion The Year Ends, but Development Continues
notes.content:
2024: A Milestone Year for Quadrillion!
This year has been truly special for us at Re:Wolves Studio – we released our game Quadrillion! We know the initial state of the game wasn’t perfect, but we’ve worked hard throughout the year to improve and rework it.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863165/4524d5078240507994648fd941e8a44035ef4e12.png

What have we improved?

Full voice acting overhaul
Redesigned missions and immersive environments
Enhanced AI that not only wields weapons and shoots but also assists you!
What’s coming in 2025?
[previewyoutube=lypmGt7mXyk;full][/previewyoutube]

More fully voiced missions
Thrilling cutscenes
Diverse environments, including winter missions
New weapons and a return to survival horror – you’ll need to search for and conserve ammo!
The first mission has been expanded with more content, dialogue, and hidden easter eggs.
When can you play it?

While we don’t have a precise date yet, we’re aiming for a release in Q1 2025!

Thank you for your support and trust.
From all of us at Re:Wolves Studio, we wish you a Happy New Year! 🎉

[previewyoutube=Q9aMESyMwd8;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Quadrillion Update #02
notes.content:
Greetings, players!

We have the latest updates on the progress of our game Quadrillion.

Updates:
Enhanced gameplay and expanded storyline: We’ve simplified the map for smoother gameplay and expanded the storyline, immersing you in the dramatic events of World War I.
Voiced NPCs: Your interaction with the game world will feel more authentic thanks to fully voiced characters.
Advanced AI for combat: Get ready to face challenging opponents that will put your tactical skills to the test.
Engaging quests and cutscenes: Each quest comes with captivating effects and cinematic cutscenes that draw you straight into the action.
Challenges for both logic and action lovers: The game combines logical puzzles with intense combat in the gritty conditions of the trenches.
We’ll keep you updated with more news soon. Thank you for your support, and we hope you’re as excited as we are!


Best regards,
the dedicated team of two developers from Re:Wolves studio TT

notes.title: Quadrillion: The Big Rework – Enhanced Graphics, New AI, and More!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863165/cbe385c59740fe60235ac9e6057ad0e9325895e3.png

QUADRILLION: Genesis of Y'garoth

What’s Happening:

We’ve decided to completely overhaul and rework Quadrillion from the ground up! Originally planned as a doom-like game without a story, it has become clear that we cannot continue without a narrative due to the project’s functionality and constraints. Thus, on August 17, 2024, we made the decision to revise the entire game. Building on the initial story framework we had implemented, we have developed an intriguing new scenario. Here’s what you can expect:

1. Universal Render Pipeline (URP) for Enhanced Graphics and Performance!

Improved Visual Quality: With URP, you'll experience better lighting, more vibrant colors, and more detailed graphics that bring every aspect of the game to life.
Optimized Performance: URP ensures smooth performance across various platforms, reducing lag and providing a smoother gaming experience on all devices.
2. New and Improved AI (NPCs):

We’re introducing a new AI system capable of shooting at you and attacking with melee weapons. We’re also working on helpful AI, including “pet AI” (like a dog). The game will feature NPCs who assign you tasks and missions. Additionally, we plan to include voice acting for some NPCs, so you’ll be able to chat with them!
3. New Environments:

As the story progresses, we’ve prepared new maps and locations for you. We’ve also improved the quest and mission systems. The new environments look fantastic!
4. Weapons:

We’re adding new weapons, including both firearms and melee weapons! We’re also working on weapon attachments. (Note: We are currently revising all animations, with a focus on adding missing reload animations!)
5. When is it Coming Out?

We’re aiming for a release in December 2024, but there might be a delay. Although we’re in an advanced stage of development, working with just two people means that things can change. However, we’re preparing many more surprises that we haven’t revealed yet.
In Conclusion:
We hope this upcoming update excites you. We’ll be sharing progress updates at least once a month, so stay tuned!

PS: Thank you for your support! As mentioned, we are a team of just two.

Best regards,
RE:Wolves Studio.
